c32a5e70: ;
 .;ENTRY POINT FOR JOT OPTIONS

4e918839: ;Check if multiple service connected sources and call division utility if so
ba5b32bb: ;If single service connected source, find the division internally
eb23d0bd: ;Call routine for the requested JOT option
63631bf7: ;Call routine to prompt for date range
6ab1d8e7: ;Set selection criteria to only allow supported document types
e5c5ac91: Prompt the user to select a Summary Type and check if the selection is valid.
fc928805: Inform the user that the output requires a 132-column format.
e191144e: Get the current date and time, format it as needed, and store it in the DGJTDAT variable.
d716fabb: Set up variables and parameters for the report, call the ZIS^DGJUTQ routine to handle device selection, and if successful, go to the START^DGJOTP1 routine.
e3024709: ;Quit if no input.
4cb56e0b: ;Initialize variables and loop through nodes in ^VAS(393) global

9d5145a1: ;If report type is 1 (Mini Co-Payment Report) or 3 (both Mini Co-Pay and Patient Treatment Status Report) and the virtual pointer array is set, initialize report variables and branch to routine DGJOTP2.
b703b32d: ;If report type is 2 (Patient Treatment Status Report) and the virtual pointer array is set, initialize report variables and branch to routine DGJOTP3.
961bb1f8: Check if there are records before proceeding
a66c7603: Quit if node does not exist, otherwise continue execution in DGJOTP routine
9cb4e7c0: Calculate total percentage from previous percentages
5493fff8: Increment total entry count and count entries with percentage greater than 30
adda6316: For physician entries, increment physician total count and count for those over 30%
56bfadf4: ;Quit if this is the PHYSICIAN procedure (PHY).

f5430412: ;If this is the SERVICE procedure (SER), increment the total count for this service at this division, and increment the 30% or more count if applicable. Then call the PC (procedure code) API.
f0e38ddc: ;If this is the SERVICE procedure (SER), increment the count for this service at this division and specialty.
a030d84d: Quit if input is empty
51213538: If case status was selected but the input data is missing the case status, quit
19f818e4: If case status was provided in input data, check if it matches the selected case status. If not, quit
d16bf1d0: If processing specific treatment, check if input data is for that same treatment type. If not, quit
b5c89b56: If processing other treatments, check if input data is for specific treatment type. If so, quit
4c9c9f30: If the treatment factor is not new admission and the node represents a discharge summary, check if the patient movement has a discharge type. If so, return the discharge type.
167f0529: Set the default value of DGJTPC based on the value of DGJTL.
b35987f5: Validate that the node is a valid document type and quit if not.
042d8adc: If VAUTN is defined and is false, check if the user has permission to see this document based on its service connected status, and quit if not.
f9a8bf2b: If VAUTT is defined and is false, check if the user has permission to see this document based on its treatment status, and quit if not.
14b06133: If VAUTY is defined and is false, check if the user has permission to see this document based on its document type, and quit if not.
c84af552: Quit if node date is before begin date or after end date
584b1336: Pull data from DGJOTPUL routine and quit if no record found
b67bc0eb: If processing outpatient records, initialize outpatient division total counter if not already set
0e4d80b9: If this is a service provider entry, truncate the service name to 23 characters and increment the service count.
c193154f: Retrieve the patient's name from the PATIENT file.
8e7acced: If this is a physician entry, set the physician name. Store the visit data in the utility global, and increment the physician count.
750e71ee: ;Assign service name and specialty based on fields in global ^DG(393.1 and ^DIC(45.7
62d51f96: ;Set the entry in the ^UTILITY global for this server/provider/patient/inpatient service
0ba7fb44: ;Quit the routine
da0a2ea6: ;Update the total counts for this server/provider
bda7c2ac: Set PHYSICIAN total for current location/procedure
af28571e: Set SERVICE total for current location/procedure
4e9eefd7: Exit routine
102e4cea: Add percentages for criteria 2, 3 and 4 to entry. If total exceeds 30, set amount over 30 as additional points for the entry.
477d1f58: Return if no physician is selected.
2cbef471: Quit the routine if no physician is selected.
bea1dd8d: Return if no service is selected.
61d9a2ca: Quit the routine if no service is selected.
fb455f40: Look up and allow selection of a specialty.
55a3b839: Return from the routine.
